# Your First Agent

*This chapter will cover:*

- The `Agent` declaration syntax (`worker = Agent { ... }`)
- Providers and models
- Writing effective system prompts
- Callable agent invocation: `worker()` and `worker({message = "..."})`
- The "done" tool pattern
- Getting results from agent interactions
- Writing a spec first (`Specifications`) and iterating in mock mode
